semiconductor_relevance: High — Better Puro Co., Ltd provides critical components for gas systems in semiconductor manufacturing plants.
summary: Better Puro Co., Ltd specializes in manufacturing super clean stainless steel pipes and fittings, essential for bulk gas and specialty gas systems in semiconductor plants. Their products are used in semiconductor, TFT/LCD, LED, and solar energy sectors, serving major clients like SMIC, Texas Instruments, and Intel.
